ordered_fail_closed_gates.requirement: Every allowed input, membership, identity, configuration and frozen hash matches the Sprint 54 specification.
Family, fitted state, schema/order, class order, modality identity, preprocessing alignment and executability are exact and complete.
Three independent TRAIN/source-only repetitions satisfy exact canonical state and output repeatability.
After G1-G3 pass, compare every row-level reconstructed raw unimodal or raw fused probability with the immutable Sprint 54 evidence under the frozen tolerance.
For multimodal identities: verify base outputs, ordered meta-features, LR fusion, raw fused probability, frozen calibration mapping, final probability and exact decision in that order.

eligibility_rule: A scope may become XAI-E1 only after its required G1-G3 gates pass and XAI-E2 only after applicable G4-G5 equivalence plus a separate method/query authorization; no gate may be skipped.
